services.titre: From the first idea to the annual return
services.detail: As an accounting, audit and advisory firm, we provide accounting, tax and management support to Cameroonian small and medium businesses.

creation.detail: Sole trader, LLC, single-member LLC, simplified joint stock, property company, public limited. Articles, registration, trade register, tax number and publication: we lodge the file for you.

adhesion.detail: We keep your books, file your monthly and annual returns, and check your documents before filing.

ponctuel.detail: Annual statistical and tax return, catch-up on a past year, support during an audit, business plan.

domiciliation.detail: A professional address in Douala, with mail handling and forwarding.

formations.detail: VAT, tax return pack, payroll and social contributions, cash records. In our offices or on your premises.

conseil.detail: Partner lawyers, notaries and chartered accountants, funding searches, banking support.

cga.titre: What membership changes for your business
cga.detail: An approved management centre is not an ordinary accounting firm: it is an association approved by the Minister of Finance, working alongside the tax administration. Membership opens real advantages, in return for books kept rigorously.

avantage1.detail: Membership of an approved centre entitles you to an allowance on declared profit. The amount and conditions depend on your tax regime.

avantage2.titre: A desk audit, not an on-site one
avantage2.detail: The administration favours documentary review for members of an approved centre. Your business is not interrupted.

avantage3.detail: The withholding rate applied to your purchases is reduced for members. Your cash flow breathes.

avantage4.titre: Errors caught before the tax office does
avantage4.detail: We check every invoice on arrival and put a figure on what an irregularity would cost. An invoice missing a tax number can be corrected in a week; discovered during an audit, it is lost.

etapes.titre: Three steps, and you follow everything online

etape1.detail: Four questions in the estimator, the amount appears, split between official fees and our own. You pay by transfer or Orange Money.

etape2.titre: We build and lodge the file
etape2.detail: You photograph your documents from your phone. We draft the articles, you review them, we lodge at the one-stop shop.

etape3.detail: Trade register, tax number, tax compliance certificate, social security numbers. Eight weeks at most after your articles are approved.

q1.question: What exactly do your prices cover?
q1.reponse: Two distinct amounts: the official fees we advance and pay on to the administrations, and our own fees. The estimator shows them separately, and your quote itemises every line.

q2.question: How long does company formation take?
q2.reponse: Eight weeks at most once your articles are reviewed and approved, and payment received. Outside Douala and Yaoundé, allow two more weeks: the file is lodged at the regional one-stop shop.

q3.question: Must I pay in the capital before registration?
q3.reponse: Yes for companies with share capital: it is placed in a blocked account, then released once the trade register entry is obtained.

q4.question: Do I need to be a large company to join?
q4.reponse: No, quite the opposite. The approved management centre is designed for very small and medium businesses, including those under the general synthetic tax regime.

q5.question: How do I send you my invoices?
q5.reponse: By WhatsApp, from the app, by email, or at one of our offices. You photograph them as you receive them; the rest is our concern.

q6.question: What if my company name is refused?
q6.reponse: We submit the second proposal at no extra cost. That is why we ask you for three from the outset.
